names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 4 Δεκεμβρίου, «Αγία Ιουλιανή», with the rank word left off. The page gives her no epithet at all, which is why this folder's name carries the day.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 4ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Αγία Ιουλιανή»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 4 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the page, and it prints no hymn and gives no year. The corpus keeps six other folders whose personal name is Juliana, all on other days and all with a place or a kinsman in their names; this one the page leaves bare, so the folder's name carries the day instead.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue as printed by pravoslavno.rs (2 October 2026).
